address: 2F, YUIMOM Residence, 815 Jiouru 1st Road, Sanmin District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan
bio: The pristine space in a serviced apartment tower is done out in brick-red hues and has trendy pendant lamps. Helmed by a Taiwanese head chef, the kitchen delivers a tasting menu that effortlessly unites local produce with influences from around the world. In addition to the main room, there are private rooms for parties and banquets.
